# Coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy

Acme Digital BV operates this policy under Annex I Part II(5) of Regulation
(EU) 2024/2847.

## How to report

Send reports to security@acmegateway.nl, or open a private report through
https://github.com/acme-digital/gateway/security/advisories/new

## What you can expect

- We acknowledge every report within 72 hours.
- We give an initial assessment within 5 business days.
- We aim to ship a fix within 90 days, and we coordinate the publication date
  with you.

## Where fixed vulnerabilities are published

Every fixed vulnerability gets a public advisory with its severity and the
versions affected. Advisories are published as GitHub Security Advisories and
mirrored in CHANGELOG.md.

## Regulatory reporting procedure (Article 14)

When we become aware that a vulnerability in this product is being actively
exploited:

1. **Within 24 hours** — early warning to our national CSIRT and to ENISA
   through the Single Reporting Platform.
2. **Within 72 hours** — vulnerability notification, with the corrective and
   mitigating measures taken.
3. **Within 14 days** — final report, once a corrective measure is available.

The on-call security lead owns this clock. The same procedure applies to a
severe incident affecting the security of the product, where the final report
is due within one month.
